guards.what: BLOAT places the spawned Gas Bomb in the wrong enemy-list position
guards.issue: LivingFog's BLOAT spawn lands in the WRONG PLACE in the enemy list, so the Gas Bomb and the Living Fog take their turns in the opposite order to the game and occupy swapped enemy indices. The game spawns the bomb into a NAMED encounter slot: LivingFog.cs:91 asks Encounter.GetNextSlot(CombatState), which (EncounterModel.cs:245-248) returns the first entry of LivingFogNormal.Slots = [bomb1, bomb2, bomb3, bomb4, bomb5, livingFog] (LivingFogNormal.cs:18) that no live enemy occupies - 'bomb1' - and passes it to CreatureCmd.Add<GasBomb>(CombatState, slot) (LivingFog.cs:95). CombatManager.AddCreature then re-sorts the whole enemy list whenever the new creature has a SlotName (CombatManager.cs:846-851 -> CombatState.SortEnemiesBySlotName, CombatState.cs:495-501, which sorts by Slots.IndexOf(SlotName)). bomb1 is index 0 and livingFog is index 5, so the game's Enemies becomes [GasBomb, LivingFog]. The sim has no slot concept for this encounter: living_fog.py:94 calls CreatureCmd.add(hooks, GasBomb(...)) with the default index=None, which APPENDS (cmds.py:262-265), giving [LivingFog, GasBomb]. Two observables follow. (1) ENEMY TURN ORDER: the game iterates _state.Enemies.ToList() (CombatManager.cs:1072) and the sim iterates list(self.enemies) (combat.py:286), so from the turn after BLOAT the game resolves the bomb's 8-damage DEATH_BLOW BEFORE the Living Fog's move and the sim resolves it AFTER - a different order of damage instances, of on_damage_received listeners and of the bomb's own death inside one enemy phase. (2) ENEMY INDEX: the bomb is index 0 in the game and index 1 in the sim, which the conformance replay compares POSITIONALLY (combat_driver.py:184-191 zips the recorded EnemyState list against the live one), so a recorded Living Fog fight reports an 'enemies' Divergence. Note the sim's `index=` parameter EXISTS and is used elsewhere for exactly this mechanism (cmds.py:243-245 documents it as the Ovicopter egg-slot rule), so the fix is to pass it, not to add machinery.
guards.rationale: EXECUTED, `py audit/tools/monster_probes_b03.py slot-order`, a real CombatState driven through ADVANCED_GAS then BLOAT: 'SIM enemies after BLOAT : [LivingFog, GasBomb]' / 'GAME enemies after BLOAT : [GasBomb, LivingFog] (slot sort over [bomb1..bomb5, livingFog])'; 'sim next enemy turn acts in order: [LivingFog, GasBomb]' vs 'game next enemy turn acts in order: [GasBomb, LivingFog]'; 'sim index of the Gas Bomb: 1' vs 'game index of the Gas Bomb: 0'. LIVE under rule 6, both sides proved reachable on ported content: 'living_fog' is in the Underdocks normal-encounter pool (rooms.py:135), the encounter is LIVING_FOG_NORMAL (living_fog.py:101-104), and the code path is taken on the second Living Fog turn of every such fight - BLOAT_MOVE is a fixed link in a branchless chain, so it CANNOT be skipped, and the free-slot test passes on turn 2 because no bomb exists yet. Nothing unported is required.

guards.what: The free-slot test itself (how many bombs may be alive)
guards.rationale: Separate from the ordering gap and correct. GetNextSlot returns string.Empty only when every entry of Slots is occupied by a creature still in CombatState.Enemies (EncounterModel.cs:245-248), and the fog permanently holds 'livingFog', so the real cap is five LIVE bombs. living_fog.py:88-93 counts `isinstance(e, GasBomb) and not e.is_gone` and gates on `< 5` (_BOMB_SLOTS = 5, :18), which is the same predicate: an exploded bomb is removed from Enemies in the game (it vetoes neither ShouldDie nor ShouldCreatureBeRemovedFromCombatAfterDeath) and is is_gone in the sim, so both sides free the slot at the same moment. BloatAmount is a field initialised to 1 and written nowhere (LivingFog.cs:22,44-55), matching _BLOAT_SPAWNS = 1.
LivingFog.cs:89-101 runs the spawn loop and THEN the 5-damage attack; living_fog.py:88-95 does the same. Observable: a Thorns-style reaction to the attack would see the bomb already present.

LivingFog.cs:32-40, LAST argument: MinInitialHp 80 (MaxInitialHp = MinInitialHp), AdvancedGasDamage 8, BloatDamage 5, SuperGasBlastDamage 8; plus Smoggy 1 (:82) and BloatAmount 1 (:22). Sim living_fog.py:13-18, 55-56.
